description: Image Description: The image showcases a display of various decorative ceramic vases and pottery items. There are three large vases prominently featured. The vase on the left is adorned with blue and yellow floral patterns with two handles. The central vase has intricate designs, depicting scenes with human figures in black and orange, characteristic of classical Greek pottery. The vase on the right is tall and slender, featuring intricate geometric and floral patterns in shades of beige and brown with a lid. Additionally, there are smaller pottery items
